query: What clustering and small-sample inference rules will we commit to (region-level, region×year, wild-cluster bootstrap) and what minimum-cluster thresholds will trigger alternative inference methods?

response.query: What clustering and small-sample inference rules will we commit to (region-level, region×year, wild-cluster bootstrap) and what minimum-cluster thresholds will trigger alternative inference methods?
response.answer: We commit to region-level clustering and region×year wild-cluster bootstrap for small-sample inference. Alternative methods are triggered if the minimum cluster count falls below 10.
